title: The Scribe: The Hunter King (Scenes 07–09)
location: Dense Vedic forest. Scene 07: open forest road churned by chariot wheels, dust, herds fleeing. Scene 08: river Malini bank, shallow clear water over white stones, ancient trees, a low thatched hermitage gate. Scene 09: sunlit hermitage interior, sacred fire altar, tall trees with flowers and fruit, deer, calm river sound.

shots.camera: Extreme wide, 24mm, low angle, slow pull-back as army flows past
shots.action: King @dushmanta rides at the head of a vast royal army — chariots, elephants, horses, foot soldiers — sweeping into a dense forest.
shots.sound: Thunder of hooves, chariot wheels on packed earth, distant elephant calls, war drums.
shots.frame: Low wide frame: forest silhouettes against bright sky. @dushmanta stands in a golden chariot at center, bow in hand. Dust clouds rise behind ranks of chariots and elephants stretching to the horizon. No stirrups, no saddles with horns.
motion: 0-4s: slow pull-back as the vast army streams past the camera.
4-7s: @dushmanta turns to scan the forest ahead, one hand raised to signal the hunt.

shots.camera: Medium wide, 50mm, handheld energy, quick pan left-to-right
shots.action: The hunt empties the forest: deer scatter in all directions, birds burst from the canopy, the earth trembles under a thousand chariots.
shots.sound: Rushing wind, animal cries, sudden silence after the stampede.
shots.frame: Forest in chaos: deer leaping right, birds erupting from treetops, dust and broken branches. @dushmanta's chariot visible at left, wheels raising a golden dust trail.
motion: 0-3s: quick pan tracks fleeing deer; army edge visible at screen-left.
3-6s: birds scatter upward; dust settles to eerie quiet.

shots.camera: Wide, 35mm, slow push toward river bank
shots.action: Alone with only his minister and priest, @dushmanta reaches the river Malini: clear water over white stones, forest flowers on the bank, the sound of the hermitage's sacred fire.
shots.sound: River water over stones, birdsong, distant sacred fire crackle. Army sounds fade behind.
shots.frame: Wide shot of the Malini river: white stones in clear shallow water, tall trees with flowers and vines arching over the bank. @dushmanta and two attendants dismount at the edge of the frame.
motion: 0-4s: slow push toward the river as @dushmanta steps down from the chariot.
4-6s: he pauses, hearing the hermitage's sacred fire and sensing the sanctity of the place.

shots.camera: Medium, 50mm, locked, then slow push through the gate
shots.action: @dushmanta walks through the hermitage gate into Kanwa's forest retreat, leaving his weapons at the threshold.
shots.sound: Gentle wind in sacred grove, bees on flowers, the fire altar's soft crackle inside.
shots.frame: Low thatched gate of the hermitage framed by flowering trees. @dushmanta leans his bow against the gate post and walks in. His minister and priest follow.
motion: 0-2s: @dushmanta sets his bow at the gate with respect.
2-5s: slow push through the gate into the sunlit grove.

shots.camera: Slow wide pan, 35mm, left to right across the empty hermitage
shots.action: @dushmanta looks around Kanwa's hermitage and finds it empty: fire burning, palm leaves set out, but no sage.
shots.sound: Sacred fire crackle, wind through banana leaves, bees, the river. No human voice.
shots.frame: Wide interior of the hermitage: a burning altar, stacks of bark-cloth and palm leaves, simple water pots. No people. Sunlight dapples through the forest canopy overhead.
motion: 0-4s: slow pan reveals the whole hermitage — fire, altar, huts — but no inhabitants.
4-6s: @dushmanta turns slowly, puzzled, then calls out.

shots.camera: Medium, 50mm, locked two-shot; she enters frame from behind a flowering tree
shots.action: @shakuntala comes out from behind a flowering tree, greets @dushmanta with the proper hermitage welcome, and says her father Kanwa has gone to gather fruit.
shots.sound: Soft footsteps on forest floor, gentle voice, river in background.
shots.frame: @shakuntala in bark-cloth and simple cotton with forest flowers in her hair, emerging from dappled shade into warm sunlight. She holds a water pot and greets the king with joined palms, calm and unafraid. No jewellery beyond what a hermitage gives.
motion: 0-3s: @shakuntala steps from behind a flowering tree; she pauses, sees the guest, and greets him calmly.
3-7s: she speaks, gesturing toward the absent guru's hut, then offers water.

shots.action: @dushmanta is struck by @shakuntala's beauty and composure; he looks at her with quiet wonder.
shots.sound: Silence except for the river; the tanpura drone returns softly.
shots.frame: Close-up of @dushmanta's face: surprised admiration, not lust. His hand tightens slightly on his quiver strap. Warm dappled forest light on his face.
motion: 0-5s: his gaze stays on @shakuntala as she looks away modestly; a faint breeze moves the flowers in her hair.

shots.action: @dushmanta asks @shakuntala who she is and whose daughter. She answers openly: Kanwa the sage is her father, though she was born of Viswamitra and the apsara Menaka.
shots.sound: Her clear voice, the fire behind them, light river sound.
shots.frame: Medium two-shot by the fire altar: @dushmanta kneeling on the ground as a respectful guest, @shakuntala standing with her water pot, speaking plainly and without shame.
motion: 0-3s: @dushmanta asks; she meets his gaze steadily.
3-6s: she answers, gesturing first toward the guru's hut, then toward the river.

shots.camera: Painterly flash series: three painted panels, 2.4s each
shots.action: Painted flashback: Viswamitra's blazing tapas on a mountain peak; Indra watches in fear from his throne and sends the apsara Menaka to break the penance; Menaka is born into the air above a river bank and lays her baby daughter on the warm grass before vanishing.
shots.sound: Ethereal shimmer, wind on a mountain peak, then silence as the baby is left alone.
shots.frame: Three separate painted still panels dissolving between: (1) Viswamitra seated on a Himalayan peak, body radiating gold tapas-fire against a violet sky; (2) Menaka dancing before Viswamitra in soft dawn mist, an apsara draped in white silk; (3) tiny baby on riverbank grass, Menaka's silk trailing away into air. Never a love scene — keep it chaste and stylized as a painted memory, not live action.
motion: 0-2.4s: first painted panel holds with slow colour bloom.
2.4-4.8s: dissolve to second panel; Menaka's silk moves gently.
4.8-7s: dissolve to third panel; the river flows past the sleeping child.

shots.action: @shakuntala finishes her story calmly, unashamed of her parentage — a great sage's daughter and an apsara's child, raised in the hermitage.
shots.sound: Her voice quiet and steady; river; end of flashback shimmer fades.
shots.frame: Medium close-up of @shakuntala's face in warm afternoon forest light: direct gaze, composure, no apology in her expression. Her bark-cloth robe and flower-decorated hair in sharp focus against soft green.
motion: 0-5s: she holds eye contact with @dushmanta as she finishes her last word; a slight proud lift of her chin.
